## Professional summary

César Gómez is a senior fullstack developer with a frontend focus. He builds high-performance websites and web products with Vue 3, Nuxt 4, TypeScript, PrimeVue, and Tailwind CSS from Cartagena de Indias, Colombia. He has led frontend architecture for ed-tech platforms serving 100,000+ students and contributed as a founding engineer on speech-based language learning products.

## Core expertise

- Vue.js and Nuxt.js (Vue 3, Nuxt 4, frontend architecture, SSR/SSG, performance)
- Senior frontend development and custom website / páginas web delivery
- TypeScript and modern JavaScript
- AI/NLP engineering (local + cloud models, Ollama, llama.cpp) and agent-assisted delivery to production
- Node.js backend APIs with Express.js (8+ years in production) and TypeScript
- Design systems, micro-frontends, and component libraries (PrimeVue, Vuetify, Tailwind CSS)
- Fullstack delivery connecting APIs to Vue/Nuxt products
- UI engineering, accessibility, CI/CD, and Web Vitals optimization
